roles.description: End users who browse restaurants and place orders. Highest-volume class; assume broad range of technical skill and primarily mobile usage. Most important class to satisfy.
Staff of partner restaurants who manage menus, toggle availability, and accept/fulfil orders. Moderate technical skill; frequent daily use during business hours.
Contract couriers who accept delivery jobs and complete drop-offs. Mobile-only; need simple, low-friction workflows and offline-tolerant behaviour.
Internal staff who onboard partners, resolve disputes, and configure platform parameters. Small population; high privilege; technically proficient.

features.name: User Registration and Authentication
features.description: Allows users of all four classes to create accounts, authenticate, and manage their profiles and saved addresses
flows: User submits registration details → system validates, creates account, and sends a verification message.
User submits credentials → system authenticates and issues a session token, or returns an error after repeated failures.
User requests password reset → system sends a time-limited reset link.
features.story: As a user, I want to create accounts, authenticate, and manage my profiles and saved addresses.

features.name: Restaurant and Menu Browsing
features.description: Lets customers discover restaurants and menu items relevant to their location and preferences
flows: Customer opens the app → system lists open restaurants that deliver to the customer's location.
Customer enters a search term or applies filters → system returns matching restaurants and items.
Customer selects a restaurant → system displays its menu, hours, rating, and delivery estimate.
features.story: As a customer, I want to discover restaurants and menu items relevant to my location and preferences.

features.name: Cart and Order Placement
features.description: Lets customers assemble an order and submit it for fulfilment
flows: Customer adds items to the cart → system updates the cart total and enforces per-restaurant rules.
Customer proceeds to checkout → system validates minimum order, delivery address, and item availability.
Customer confirms the order → system creates the order, initiates payment, and notifies the restaurant.
features.story: As a customer, I want to assemble an order and submit it for fulfilment.

features.name: Payment Processing
features.description: Handles secure collection of payment and issuance of refunds
flows: Customer selects a payment method and confirms → system requests authorization from the gateway.
Gateway returns success → system marks the order paid and proceeds; on failure the system keeps the order unpaid and prompts the customer to retry.
An eligible cancellation or dispute is resolved in the customer's favour → system issues a refund through the gateway.
features.story: As a customer, I want payment processing.

features.name: Order Tracking and Delivery Management
features.description: Coordinates assignment of a delivery agent and provides real-time tracking to the customer
flows: Restaurant marks an order ready → system assigns an available nearby delivery agent.
Delivery agent accepts the job → system shares pickup and drop-off details and begins tracking.
Delivery agent updates status / location → system relays live progress and ETA to the customer.
features.story: As a delivery agent, I want order tracking and delivery management.

features.name: Ratings and Reviews
features.description: Lets customers provide feedback on completed orders
flows: Order is delivered → system invites the customer to rate and review.
Customer submits a rating and optional text → system records it and updates the restaurant's average rating.
features.story: As a customer, I want to provide feedback on completed orders.

features.name: Restaurant Partner Menu Management
features.description: Lets restaurant managers maintain their menu, pricing, and availability, and manage incoming orders
flows: Manager edits the menu → system validates and publishes changes to customers.
New order arrives → system alerts the manager, who accepts or rejects it and later marks it ready.
features.story: As a restaurant manager, I want to maintain my menu, pricing, and availability, and manage incoming orders.

features.name: Administration and Platform Management
features.description: Gives administrators control over partners, users, disputes, and platform configuration
flows: Administrator onboards a restaurant → system creates the partner account and portal access.
Administrator reviews a dispute → system applies the resolution, including any refund.
features.story: As a platform administrator, I want control over partners, users, disputes, and platform configuration.
